steps.title: Do Theatre of Blood/Hard Mode if …
steps.text: Do Theatre of Blood/Hard Mode if you have the skills and team to do so

steps.title: The Justiciar armour can be stored …
steps.text: The Justiciar armour can be stored in your house and if you get the full set it might be nice for something in the future

steps.title: Remember that you can leave stacks …
steps.text: Remember that you can leave stacks of 100k in your GE bond offer slots to pay for death fees more quickly

steps.title: You may want to add a …
steps.text: You may want to add a seed box to hold the seed drops if you can afford the slot

steps.title: Use thralls in all setups, the …
steps.text: Use thralls in all setups, the damage adds up. — You can clan wars minigame teleport after each raid to bag your loot

steps.title: Use extra supplies from the raid …
steps.text: Use extra supplies from the raid to refill your Chugging barrel. You may want to intentionally start the raid with a few slots empty if you don't need the extra supplies. — Prayer potions can also be used in place of a few Super restores as they cost fewer points to buy.
